type.notes_type: A lattice, not a ratio: bitmap faces render clean only at native ppem, so sizes are 8/10/16/32px exactly and line-heights are whole pixels (10/15/16/24px). fluid_type: false.

texture.dither_tile: 4x4 base64 PNG stamped at background-size: 2px 2px (inputs, overlays, scrollbar track) — not a CSS gradient

cursors.grab: grab.svg (5 0) — on the window drag handle

notes: Normalized from raw/poolsuite.{json,css,html}, corroborated against desktop.png, mobile.png and frames s00-s10. The page does not scroll: s00-s10 are pixel-identical except the media filename in the player status strip, so motion.scroll_effects is empty — the three effects the probe diffed (span.absolute opacity/scale, w3m-modal pin) belong to Tailwind's `ping` utility and a hidden third-party wallet modal (fixed, opacity 0, pointer-events none), not to the design. Colors taken from the LIVE :root override on <html> (--backgroundOverwrite #F6D5D5 / --button #F6D5D5 / --secondary-button #AFE2E5), which the runtime sets per session; the stylesheet's static :root defaults differ slightly (#f7d5d5 / #afe5dd) — screenshots decide. borderColor came back as rgb(229,231,235) ×1276, which is Tailwind's unused default border color on elements with border-width 0; every visible rule in the screenshots is 1px #000, so the probe value was dropped. Radii collapsed from 1-6px to the 2/3/4/6 band actually in use. The 'dark' theme block in craft.theme is present but supportsDark is false — it is the cream light theme re-sampled, so no color.dark is emitted. Type sizes reported as px (8/10/16/32) and expressed in rem here; bitmap faces must not be scaled off these values.
